title: VLuckyMine
description: V-LuckyMine - Spawn lucky chests when mining blocks!
body:
# 🎲 V-LuckyMine

[![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.1-blue.svg)](https://papermc.io)
[![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21-orange.svg)](https://adoptium.net)

 ⚡ **Zero-lag** lucky container spawning system for Paper servers  
 🎨 **Fully configurable** loot tables, block chances & container types  
 🔒 **Simple & lightweight** — no bloat, just fun!

Transform mining into a thrilling treasure hunt! V-LuckyMine spawns magical containers filled with custom loot whenever players mine specific blocks. Perfect for survival servers, RPG worlds, or minigame lobbies.

---

## ✨ Features

- 🎲 **Chance-based spawning** — Configure unique probabilities for every block type
- 📦 **16+ Container types** — Chests, Shulkers, Barrels, Hoppers, Droppers, Dispensers & more
- 🎯 **Visual GUI editor** — Manage everything in-game with `/lm`
- ⏱️ **Auto-despawn** — Containers vanish after configurable time (default: 10 seconds)
- 🎨 **Per-item chances** — Each loot item has its own independent spawn probability
- ⚡ **Async operations** — Zero server lag guaranteed
- 🔧 **Live reload** — Update configs without restarts

---
## 📥 Installation

1. **Download** the latest `V-LuckyMine-1.0.0.jar` 
2. **Upload** the JAR file to your server's `plugins/` folder
3. **Restart** your Paper server (Java 21+ required)
4. **Run** `/lm` as OP to configure via GUI
5. **Enjoy** the treasure hunting experience!

---

## 🛠️ Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/lm` or `/luckymine` | Open the GUI menu | `luckymine.admin` |
| `/lm reload` | Reload `config.yml` and `loot.yml` | `luckymine.admin` |
| `/lm createnbt <name>` | Create loot table by right-clicking a chest | `luckymine.admin` |
| `/lm cancel` | Cancel active `createnbt` session | `luckymine.admin` |

**Alias:** `/lm` (works for all commands)

> 🔒 All commands are **OP-only** and hidden from non-ops

---

## 🔐 Permissions

| Permission | Default | Description |
|------------|---------|-------------|
| `luckymine.admin` | OP | Full access to GUI and commands |
| `luckymine.lucky` | Everyone | Allows triggering lucky containers when mining |
